portfolio.name: Hashan Perera
portfolio.summary: Software engineer with 3+ years of experience building, supporting, and deploying production applications across .NET, Angular, React, NestJS, MongoDB, SQL Server, and AWS.
about: I build software that connects thoughtful interfaces with dependable systems. Based in Horana, Sri Lanka, my work spans enterprise .NET applications, Angular and NestJS platforms, and mobile tools that work even when connectivity doesn’t.

Currently at IGT1 Lanka – Sitecore, I investigate production incidents, debug .NET applications, and deliver carefully validated fixes for global customers. Previously at DigitusTec, I led a three-engineer team and built full-stack business applications with SAP Business One integrations.

I care about clean architecture, secure APIs, and the details that make software reliable. I use AI-assisted tools for coding, debugging, refactoring, and testing, grounded in code review and engineering fundamentals.

experience.summary: I resolve production issues and deliver validated fixes for enterprise Sitecore XP and .NET applications used by global customers.
highlights: Investigate incidents across application code, .NET assemblies, SQL Server data, configuration, and runtime behavior.
Implement and validate code-level fixes with a focus on regression risk and production stability.
Work within structured engineering, troubleshooting, and customer communication practices.

points: Investigate and resolve production incidents for enterprise Sitecore XP and .NET applications used by global customers, performing root-cause analysis across application code, .NET assemblies, SQL Server data, configuration, and runtime behavior.
Debug .NET-based applications and implement code level fixes for identified defects, validating changes carefully to minimize regression risk and maintain production stability.
Work within a large enterprise software environment, developing and validating solutions while following structured engineering, troubleshooting, and customer communication practices.

experience.summary: I led platform delivery and built full-stack meeting, CRM, quality-control, and agricultural systems with Angular, NestJS, and SAP B1 integrations.
highlights: Led the Meeting Minutes platform for a three-engineer team, defining Angular architecture, project structure, CI/CD workflows, and code review practices.
Built meetings, tasks, and approvals modules; implemented Auth0 JWT authentication, RBAC, Docker deployment standards, and MongoDB query optimizations.
Delivered CRM workflows, contributed SAP B1 integrations for quality control, and built core CYOL agricultural management modules.

responsibilityGroups.title: Meeting Minutes Platform
points: Led the end-to-end development of the Meeting Minutes platform as Lead Developer, defining the Angular architecture, project structure, and CI/CD workflows for a 3-engineer team, while conducting regular code reviews to maintain code quality and consistency.

Designed and developed responsive Angular modules for meetings, tasks, and approvals, integrating REST APIs and optimizing large data tables (rendering, filtering, pagination), resulting in improved usability and performance at scale.

Architected the backend using NestJS, implementing a robust RBAC security model with Auth0 JWT authentication and Docker-based deployment standards, ensuring enterprise grade security and production readiness for the Phase 1 release.
Optimized MongoDB queries using aggregation pipelines and indexing strategies, significantly improving API response times and overall system performance.

responsibilityGroups.title: CRM System
points: Developed key CRM modules including Lead Management, Customer Management, Sales Pipeline, and Cold Calling workflows using Angular and TypeScript, delivering responsive and reusable frontend components.

Adopted an AI-driven development approach using Antigravity alongside SonarQube, accelerating feature implementation, code refactoring, and quality validation while maintaining high code-quality standards.

responsibilityGroups.title: Quality Control System (Zambia)
points: Contributed to integrating the application with the SAP B1 ERP systems, Covered key workflows, including PO, GRN, Goods Returns, Production Receipts, and IBT.

responsibilityGroups.title: CYOL
points: Developed and delivered key business modules including Farmer, Farm, Expense, Outgrower, Loan, and Crop Management, handling full-stack implementation across Angular, NestJS, and MongoDB, including database design, data seeding, API development, and end-to-end feature integration.

experience.summary: I solely developed an offline-first agricultural app for 500+ users in Zambia, connecting Flutter field workflows to a NestJS backend and SAP B1.
highlights: Solely developed the Outgrower mobile app, enabling field access for 500+ users.
Used Flutter, GetX, and Hive for offline storage with queued synchronization and retry handling.
Developed the NestJS backend and integrated the SAP B1 Service Layer.

responsibilityGroups.title: OUTGROWER Mobile App (Zambia)
points: Solely developed an offline first mobile application for a Zambian agricultural company to manage external farmers and enabling field access for 500+ users.
Implemented Flutter (GetX) for state management with Hive for local offline storage, including a queued synchronization mechanism with retry handling to support low-connectivity environments.
Developed a scalable NestJS backend and integrated with SAP B1 Service Layer. Responsive flutter UI and optimized for field usage.

experience.summary: I began my software engineering career as a trainee at DigitusTec.
